news.titleEn: Iran Says It Targeted Oil Tankers in Response to US Strikes
news.conclusionEn: The US said it permanently disabled or destroyed three Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island and Jask after its warships were fired on, and Iran's Revolutionary Guards retaliated by hitting three tankers and three US-linked vessels in the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend, pushing Brent crude to around $96-97 a barrel.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊互袭油轮，霍尔木兹海峡冲突升级，布伦特原油升至约96美元。
news.whyEn: About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through the Strait of Hormuz, so a lasting risk premium feeds directly into global inflation, fuel and shipping costs, and central-bank rate decisions.
news.whyZh: 全球约五分之一海运石油经由霍尔木兹海峡，油价溢价直接推高通胀、油价、运费与利率压力。
news.detailEn: US Central Command said it struck the IRGC-linked carriers M/T Downy and M/T Stark 1 and destroyed the empty tanker M/T Kylo after a US aircraft carrier and destroyer evaded Iranian missile fire. Tehran responded Saturday evening by targeting commercial and US-linked ships transiting Hormuz and firing a ballistic missile toward US warships. Despite months of tit-for-tat attacks, crude is still flowing and Iraqi exports have held up, but analysts expect prices to stay elevated while tankers face attack risk. The oil spike is a main driver of the recent surge in global bond yields and renewed inflation worries pressing on the Fed and the ECB. Markets are watching whether either side escalates toward a broader closure of the strait.
news.detailZh: 美军中央司令部称，在美方航母和驱逐舰躲过伊朗导弹袭击后，打击了伊斯兰革命卫队关联的「Downy」号和「Stark 1」号油轮，并摧毁空载油轮「Kylo」号。德黑兰周六晚间以打击过境霍尔木兹海峡的商船和美国关联船只作为报复，并向美军军舰发射一枚弹道导弹。尽管双方数月来你来我往，原油仍在外运，伊拉克出口也保持稳定，但分析师预计只要油轮面临袭击风险，油价就会维持高位。此轮油价飙升是近期全球债券收益率跳升和通胀担忧重燃的主因，正对美联储和欧洲央行构成压力。市场关注任何一方是否会升级至更大范围封锁海峡。

news.titleEn: The inflation genie could be out of the bottle - and bond markets are sounding the alarm
news.conclusionEn: A synchronized global bond sell-off has pushed Japan's 10-year yield to 3% (its highest since 1996), UK gilt yields to a post-2008 peak, Germany's 10-year to its highest since 2011 and the US 10-year Treasury to about 4.78%, the most since early 2025.
news.conclusionZh: 全球国债同步抛售，日债10年期收益率触及3%创1996年来新高，美债升至约4.78%。
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields lift borrowing costs for governments, companies and households worldwide, tighten financial conditions before central banks even act, and pull money out of equities.
news.whyZh: 长端收益率走高会抬高全球政府、企业和家庭的融资成本，在央行行动前就收紧金融环境，并促使资金撤出股市。
news.detailEn: The latest leg blends record government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has revived inflation fears, and expectations that central banks stay tighter for longer. Japan is especially exposed with government debt above 200% of GDP, so higher rates sharply raise its debt-service bill. Higher yields ripple into mortgages, corporate loans and emerging-market financing. Investors now question whether expensive debt is a lasting feature rather than a passing spike. Attention turns to Friday's US August CPI, the last major reading before the Fed's Sept. 15-16 meeting.
news.detailZh: 本轮抛售叠加了创纪录的政府债券发行、重燃通胀担忧的油价冲击，以及市场对央行更长时间维持紧缩的预期。日本尤其脆弱，其政府债务超过GDP的200%，利率上升会大幅推高偿债成本。收益率走高会传导至房贷、企业贷款和新兴市场融资。投资者开始怀疑高利率债务是长期常态而非短暂波动。市场焦点转向周五公布的美国8月CPI，这是美联储9月15至16日会议前最后的重要数据。

news.titleEn: Jobs report August 2026: Payrolls jump by 162,000, unemployment holds at 4.1%
news.conclusionEn: US employers added 162,000 jobs in August, far above the roughly 53,000 economists expected, with unemployment steady at 4.1% and leisure and hospitality leading gains while information and financial jobs fell.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月新增非农就业16.2万人，远超预期，失业率维持4.1%。
news.whyEn: The firmer-than-expected labor data raises the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the Sept. 15-16 meeting, lifting Treasury yields and pressuring stocks and borrowing costs.
news.whyZh: 强于预期的就业数据令美联储9月会议加息概率上升，推高美债收益率并施压股市与融资成本。
news.detailEn: The August gain was one of the strongest of the year and well above the prior 12-month average of about 31,000. Bars and restaurants drove hiring while information-sector jobs declined, partly reflecting AI-driven efficiency. The unemployment rate held even as labor-force participation rose 0.2 point. Traders lifted bets on a September hike, though the decision hinges on Friday's August CPI, where core inflation is expected near 2.4% year on year. A hike against a slowing economy would be unusual but reflects officials' worry that oil-driven inflation is proving sticky.
news.detailZh: 8月新增就业为今年最强劲之一，远高于此前12个月约3.1万的平均水平。酒吧餐饮业带动招聘，信息行业岗位减少，部分反映AI带来的效率提升。尽管劳动参与率上升0.2个百分点，失业率仍保持不变。交易员加大对9月加息的押注，但决议取决于周五的8月CPI，核心通胀预计同比约2.4%。在经济放缓背景下加息并不寻常，反映官员担忧油价推动的通胀难以消退。

news.titleEn: ECB Doubles Down as G7's Hawk With Another Rate Hike Due This Week
news.conclusionEn: The European Central Bank is widely expected to raise its policy rate by a quarter point to 2.5% on Thursday, its second hike of 2026, after euro-zone inflation climbed back above 3% on surging energy prices.
news.conclusionZh: 欧洲央行预计本周四加息25个基点至2.5%，为2026年第二次加息。
news.whyEn: The ECB is now the most hawkish major central bank, and further tightening raises borrowing costs across the bloc while adding to the global upward move in yields.
news.whyZh: 欧洲央行已成为主要央行中最鹰派者，继续收紧将抬高整个欧元区的借贷成本，并加剧全球收益率上行。
news.detailEn: The ECB raised rates for the first time in nearly three years in June, paused in July, and now appears set to resume tightening as energy inflation runs near 14% because of the Middle East conflict. Underlying price pressures are actually cooling - core inflation is around 2.4% - which complicates the message. Officials from Spain to Germany face divergent national inflation rates, from about 4.5% in Spain to 2.9% in Germany. A September move would align the ECB with a broader central-bank shift toward guarding against a second inflation wave. Markets will parse the ECB's new forecasts for signals on whether more hikes follow.
news.detailZh: 欧洲央行6月近三年来首次加息，7月暂停，如今看来将恢复收紧，因中东冲突推动能源通胀升至约14%。但基础价格压力实际上在降温，核心通胀约2.4%，令政策沟通更为复杂。从西班牙约4.5%到德国2.9%，各成员国通胀分化明显。9月加息将使欧洲央行与更广泛的央行趋势一致，即防范第二波通胀。市场将解读欧洲央行的新预测，寻找是否会继续加息的信号。

news.titleEn: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
news.conclusionEn: A Boeing 767-300 operating a Prime Air cargo flight for Amazon, flown by contractor 21 Air, overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday afternoon after arriving from San Juan, crossed a road, struck multiple vehicles and caught fire, killing at least five people.
news.conclusionZh: 亚马逊一架波音767货机在迈阿密机场冲出跑道起火，至少5人死亡。
news.whyEn: It is one of the deadliest US cargo-aviation accidents in years, will trigger NTSB and FAA investigations, and renews scrutiny of Boeing jets and outsourced cargo carriers.
news.whyZh: 这是美国近年来最致命的货运航空事故之一，将引发NTSB和FAA调查，并再度引发对波音客机和外包货运商的关注。
news.detailEn: The aircraft continued past the airfield boundary near Northwest 42nd Avenue around 2 p.m. ET, striking vehicles on the ground; more than 60 Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units responded. The crash forced a roughly three-hour ground stop, and delays into the airport stretched to about six and a half hours by Sunday night. Amazon said it would cooperate fully with the investigation. The NTSB is gathering information and the FAA will lead the safety probe. Investigators will examine the landing approach, runway conditions and the 767's braking and thrust-reverser systems.
news.detailZh: 美东时间下午2点左右，飞机冲过机场边界，在西北42大道附近撞上地面车辆；迈阿密戴德消防救援出动逾60个单位。事故导致机场地面停飞约三小时，到周日夜间抵港航班延误累计约六个半小时。亚马逊表示将全面配合调查。NTSB正在收集信息，FAA将主导安全调查。调查人员将检查着陆进近、跑道状况以及这架767的刹车和反推系统。

news.titleEn: Nationalist AfD party scores first place in key regional election in Germany
news.conclusionEn: The far-right Alternative for Germany won Sunday's state election in Saxony-Anhalt with about 44.5% of the vote, far ahead of the Christian Democrats on roughly 18.5%, but is still expected to fall short of a governing majority.
news.conclusionZh: 德国极右翼政党AfD在萨克森-安哈尔特州选举中以约44.5%得票率居首。
news.whyEn: It is the AfD's strongest state result yet and a test of whether Germany's mainstream parties can keep sustaining their 'firewall' against governing with the far right.
news.whyZh: 这是AfD迄今最强的州选举结果，考验德国主流政党能否继续维持不与极右翼联合执政的「防火墙」。
news.detailEn: The AfD, classified as a right-wing extremist group by Germany's domestic intelligence agency, roughly doubled its 2021 result in the eastern state. The CDU, Left, Greens and Social Democrats trailed well behind. Because rival parties refuse to form a coalition with the AfD, government formation will be difficult and could require an unwieldy multi-party arrangement. A future AfD-led state government would be the first far-right control of a German state since World War II. The result adds pressure on Chancellor Friedrich Merz's federal coalition ahead of nationwide votes.
news.detailZh: 被德国国内情报机构定性为右翼极端组织的AfD，在这个东部州的得票率较2021年几乎翻倍。基民盟、左翼党、绿党和社民党均远远落后。由于其他政党拒绝与AfD组阁，政府组建将十分困难，可能需要笨重的多党联合。未来若出现AfD主导的州政府，将是二战以来极右翼首次掌控德国一个州。该结果加大了对默茨总理联邦执政联盟的压力。

news.titleEn: Witkoff confident of 'good resolution' after Kyiv meeting, as US pushes for trilateral talks with Russia
news.conclusionEn: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held their first talks in Kyiv with President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday, one day after meeting Vladimir Putin in Moscow, and called the discussions substantive as Washington presses for three-way negotiations to end the war.
news.conclusionZh: 美国特使威特科夫和库什纳在会晤普京次日抵基辅，与泽连斯基举行首次会谈。
news.whyEn: It is the most concrete diplomatic push in months toward ending the Russia-Ukraine war, with implications for European security, energy prices and defense spending.
news.whyZh: 这是数月来推动结束俄乌战争最具体的外交行动，事关欧洲安全、能源价格和国防开支。
news.detailEn: The envoys arrived by train from Poland and were greeted by Zelensky outside Kyiv's Saint Sophia Cathedral. Russia and Ukraine agreed to pause aerial attacks on each other's capitals over the weekend to allow the visits, though no broader ceasefire is in place. Zelensky stressed the need for security guarantees and a 'dignified' peace, while US officials focused on Ukraine's immediate winter energy needs. Further talks are expected to include national security advisers from France, Germany and the UK. Witkoff said he looked forward to a possible trilateral meeting involving Russia.
news.detailZh: 两位特使从波兰乘火车抵达，泽连斯基在基辅圣索菲亚大教堂外迎接。俄乌同意周末暂停互相空袭对方首都以便访问成行，但尚无更广泛的停火。泽连斯基强调需要安全保障和「有尊严的」和平，美方官员则关注乌克兰迫在眉睫的过冬能源需求。后续会谈预计将纳入法、德、英三国的国家安全顾问。威特科夫表示，期待可能举行包括俄罗斯在内的三方会晤。

news.titleEn: Tesla's stock drops as Cybercab update 'underwhelms' Wall Street
news.conclusionEn: Tesla shares fell about 6% on Friday after an invite-only Cybercab event in Austin - with no Elon Musk appearance and no livestream - failed to impress investors, and as US regulators opened an audit query into how Tesla self-certified the vehicle.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉Cybercab发布会令华尔街失望，股价周五下跌约6%。
news.whyEn: Tesla's valuation increasingly rests on its robotaxi ambitions, and signs of slow rollout and regulatory friction undercut the bull case against market leader Waymo.
news.whyZh: 特斯拉估值越来越依赖其robotaxi前景，推进缓慢和监管摩擦削弱了对抗行业领跑者Waymo的多头逻辑。
news.detailEn: Tesla said riders in its robotaxi app could now hail a driverless Cybercab within a geofenced area of Austin, but analysts at Wells Fargo headlined a note 'TSLA Cybercab Launch Event Underwhelms' and flagged early execution issues. Users posted videos of routing errors, missed stops and long wait times. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an 'audit query' to check whether Tesla properly certified the Cybercab as compliant with federal safety standards. The stock's drop erased a 5.4% gain the day before. Investors now look to Tesla's next delivery and robotaxi expansion updates for proof of scale.
news.detailZh: 特斯拉称其robotaxi应用用户现可在奥斯汀一处地理围栏区域内叫到无人驾驶的Cybercab，但富国银行分析师以「特斯拉Cybercab发布会令人失望」为报告标题，并指出早期执行问题。用户发布了路线错误、错过停靠点和长时间等待的视频。美国国家公路交通安全管理局启动「审计问询」，核查特斯拉是否正确认证Cybercab符合联邦安全标准。当日股价下跌抹去了前一日5.4%的涨幅。投资者将关注特斯拉下一次交付和robotaxi扩张的进展，以验证其规模化能力。

news.titleEn: Dutch central bank shifts billions in gold from US to Britain in 'crisis preparedness' move
news.conclusionEn: The Dutch central bank (DNB) said it moved about 86 tonnes of gold out of the United States and Canada to London between March and August, cutting the share held in New York and Ottawa to 18.5% each while raising London's share to 32.1%, citing 'increasing geopolitical unrest'.
news.conclusionZh: 荷兰央行将约86吨黄金从美加转移至伦敦，称因「地缘政治动荡加剧」。
news.whyEn: A G10 central bank publicly repositioning reserves for faster access in a crisis is a notable signal about official-sector confidence in where gold is safest and most liquid.
news.whyZh: 一家G10央行公开调整储备布局以便危机时更快动用，是官方部门对黄金存放地安全性与流动性信心的显著信号。
news.detailEn: DNB said gold in London can be traded and mobilized faster than bullion in New York or Ottawa, making it the quickest to deploy in a crisis. The transfer was done partly by buying and selling and partly by physically shipping bars, including routing more than 27 tonnes through the Dutch town of Zeist to avoid melting them down. The move coincides with record central-bank gold buying globally and gold prices that have climbed sharply in 2026. Analysts read it as part of a broader trend of reserve managers hedging against political and financial fragmentation. The Netherlands holds one of the larger gold reserves in Europe.
news.detailZh: 荷兰央行称，存放伦敦的黄金比纽约或渥太华的金条交易和调动更快，危机时最便于动用。此次转移部分通过买卖完成，部分通过实物运输金条，其中逾27吨经荷兰泽斯特中转以避免熔铸。此举正值全球央行创纪录购金、金价在2026年大幅攀升之际。分析师认为，这是储备管理者对冲政治与金融割裂的更广泛趋势的一部分。荷兰持有欧洲较大规模的黄金储备之一。

businessTips.explanationEn: Switching costs are the one-time burdens - money, time, effort, risk or lost data - a customer must absorb to move from your product to a competitor's. High switching costs make revenue stickier and give you pricing power, because customers stay even when a rival looks slightly better or cheaper. They can be contractual (termination fees), procedural (migrating data, retraining staff) or psychological (learned habits, trust). Building them ethically means deepening integration and value over time, not trapping people with hidden penalties.
businessTips.explanationZh: 转换成本是指客户从你的产品转向竞争对手时必须承担的一次性代价——金钱、时间、精力、风险或数据损失。高转换成本让收入更稳定，也赋予你定价权，因为即使对手看起来略好或略便宜，客户仍会留下。它可以是合同层面的（违约金）、流程层面的（数据迁移、员工再培训），也可以是心理层面的（使用习惯、信任）。合理地建立转换成本，是靠长期加深整合与价值，而不是用隐藏的惩罚困住客户。
businessTips.exampleEn: A payroll software company stores years of tax filings, employee records and custom pay rules for each client. Even when a cheaper competitor appears, most clients stay because re-entering all that data and retraining their HR team would cost weeks of work and risk a missed payroll run.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家薪资软件公司为每个客户存有多年的报税记录、员工档案和自定义薪酬规则。即便出现更便宜的竞品，多数客户仍选择留下，因为重新录入这些数据、再培训HR团队要耗费数周，还可能导致漏发工资。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means funding a business from personal savings and, crucially, from its own early revenue, instead of raising outside investment. It forces discipline: you must reach paying customers fast, keep fixed costs low, and let cash flow - not a funding round - set your pace of growth. The upside is full ownership and control and no pressure to chase a big exit; the downside is slower scaling and real personal financial risk. It suits side hustles and niche businesses where you can charge from day one.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自筹启动（bootstrapping）是指靠个人积蓄、以及关键的自身早期收入来为生意提供资金，而不是引入外部投资。它逼你自律：必须快速找到付费客户、压低固定成本，并让现金流——而非融资轮次——决定增长节奏。好处是完全掌握所有权和控制权，没有追求大额退出的压力；坏处是扩张更慢，且个人要承担真实的财务风险。它适合那些第一天就能收费的副业和垂直细分生意。
businessTips.exampleEn: A designer starts a weekend Notion-template business with $200 for a landing page and email tool. She reinvests the first few months of sales into ads and better templates, growing to a few thousand dollars a month without ever taking a loan or an investor.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位设计师用200美元搭建落地页和邮件工具，利用周末做Notion模板生意。她把最初几个月的销售额重新投入广告和更好的模板，在从未借贷或引入投资人的情况下，做到每月几千美元收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: A credit spread is the extra yield a bond pays over a 'risk-free' government bond of the same maturity, compensating investors for default risk. When investors turn nervous about the economy or a specific borrower, they demand a bigger spread, so spreads widen and those bond prices fall; when confidence returns, spreads narrow. Watching spreads - especially on lower-rated 'high-yield' bonds - is a fast way to read how much stress the market sees, often before stock markets react.
businessTips.explanationZh: 信用利差是指一只债券相对同期限「无风险」国债多支付的收益率，用来补偿投资者承担的违约风险。当投资者对经济或某个借款人感到担忧时，会要求更高的利差，于是利差走阔、这些债券价格下跌；信心恢复时，利差收窄。观察利差——尤其是评级较低的「高收益」债券——是快速判断市场压力程度的方法，往往先于股市反应。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a 10-year US Treasury yields 4.8% and a 10-year bond from a mid-rated company yields 7.3%, the credit spread is 2.5 percentage points. If recession fears grow and that company bond moves to 9.0% while Treasuries hold steady, the spread has widened to 4.2 points - a warning sign about credit conditions.
businessTips.exampleZh: 若10年期美国国债收益率为4.8%，一家中等评级公司的10年期债券收益率为7.3%，则信用利差为2.5个百分点。如果衰退担忧升温，该公司债券收益率升至9.0%而国债保持不变，利差就走阔到4.2个百分点——这是信用环境恶化的警示信号。
